title: Echinacoside regulates the IRE1/XBP1 signaling pathway through HSP72 to reduce endoplasmic reticulum stress and improve diabetic kidney disease.
authors: Geng, Ruoyu; Ma, Chong; Wen, Limei; Dai, Wu; Liu, Jiangyun; Yang, Jianhua; Hu, Junping
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药成分松果菊苷通过HSP72调控IRE1/XBP1通路改善糖尿病肾病，核心是药物-蛋白互作与疾病机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD), a predominant driver of end-stage renal disease, intimately linked to endoplasmic reticulum stress. Echinacoside (Ech), a naturally derived phenylethanoid glycoside, exhibits diverse pharmacological activities; however, its mechanism of action in ameliorating DKD remains unclear. OBJECTIVE: To clarify the underlying molecular mechanisms of Ech's therapeutic impact on DKD. METHODS: DKD models were established using db/db mice and high glucose-induced HK-2 cells. The anti-DKD effects of Ech were systematically evaluated. Kidney proteomic sequencing was employed to screen for potential regulatory proteins, which identified Heat Shock Protein 72 (HSP72) as a core target. The IRE1/XBP1 (UPR) pathway was investigated given the established role of HSP72 as a key molecular chaperone in modulating this signaling cascade. Surface plasmon resonance (SPR), microscale thermophoresis (MST), and molecular dynamics simulations (MD) were utilized to validate interactions between Ech and HSP72. Finally, HSP72 knockdown models were generated in both in vivo and in vitro to conclusively validate Ech mechanism of action. RESULTS: Ech intervention ameliorated DKD in db/db mice, as evidenced by improved insulin resistance, restored glucolipid metabolic homeostasis, and attenuated kidney injury and fibrosis. Furthermore, it protected HK-2 cells against high glucose-induced cytotoxicity, reactive oxygen species (ROS)-mediated damage, and mitochondrial oxidative stress. Mechanistically, kidney proteomics revealed that Ech markedly upregulated HSP72 expression. SPR, MST, and MD results established HSP72 as a direct target of Ech, and the gene knockdown experiments demonstrated that the therapeutic efficacy of Ech against DKD was significantly abrogated in the absence of HSP72. Through direct interaction with HSP72, Ech activated the IRE1/XBP1 pathway, thereby alleviating endoplasmic reticulum stress, reducing mitochondrial oxidative stress, and suppressing apoptosis, ultimately ameliorating DKD. CONCLUSION: Our study demonstrates that Ech ameliorates DKD by targeting HSP72 to activate the IRE1/XBP1 pathway, thereby mitigating mitochondrial and endoplasmic reticulum stress and reducing kidney apoptosis. These findings highlight the potential of Ech as a therapeutic agent for DKD.
abstract_zh: 引言：糖尿病肾病（DKD）是终末期肾病的主要驱动因素，与内质网应激密切相关。毛蕊花糖苷（Ech）是一种天然来源的苯乙醇苷类化合物，具有多种药理活性；然而，其在改善DKD中的作用机制尚不明确。目的：阐明Ech对DKD治疗作用的潜在分子机制。方法：采用db/db小鼠和高糖诱导的HK-2细胞建立DKD模型。系统评估Ech的抗DKD效果。通过肾脏蛋白质组学测序筛选潜在调控蛋白，鉴定出热休克蛋白72（HSP72）为核心靶点。鉴于HSP72作为关键分子伴侣在调节该信号级联中的既定作用，研究了IRE1/XBP1（UPR）通路。利用表面等离子体共振（SPR）、微量热泳动（MST）和分子动力学模拟（MD）验证Ech与HSP72之间的相互作用。最后，在体内和体外均构建了HSP72敲低模型，以确证Ech的作用机制。结果：Ech干预改善了db/db小鼠的DKD，表现为胰岛素抵抗改善、糖脂代谢稳态恢复以及肾损伤和纤维化减轻。此外，它保护HK-2细胞免受高糖诱导的细胞毒性、活性氧（ROS）介导的损伤和线粒体氧化应激。机制上，肾脏蛋白质组学显示Ech显著上调HSP72表达。SPR、MST和MD结果确定HSP72为Ech的直接靶点，基因敲低实验表明，在缺乏HSP72的情况下，Ech对DKD的治疗效果显著减弱。通过与HSP72直接相互作用，Ech激活IRE1/XBP1通路，从而减轻内质网应激、减少线粒体氧化应激并抑制细胞凋亡，最终改善DKD。结论：我们的研究表明，Ech通过靶向HSP72激活IRE1/XBP1通路，从而减轻线粒体和内质网应激并减少肾脏细胞凋亡，进而改善DKD。这些发现凸显了Ech作为DKD治疗药物的潜力。
